context: Four generations of women gather. Hina now older, Hikari there too.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 皆さん、ようこそ。お祖母ちゃんも、嬉しい。
lines.en: Everyone, welcome. Grandma is so happy you're here.
lines.style: Open with a soft, genuine smile in the voice. Warm and unhurried. The kind of grandmother-tone that makes people feel immediately safe. Gentle throughout, no performative brightness—just real tenderness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お母さん、皆で、こうやって、集まれて、本当に、嬉しい。
lines.en: Mom, being able to gather like this with everyone—it truly makes me happy.
lines.style: Speaking to her mother, voice warm and reverent. Measured, as if savoring the moment. Soft undercurrent of gratitude beneath every word. The steadiness of someone who knows what matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ひかりちゃんも、お祖母ちゃん、大好きです。
lines.style: Spoken with gentle certainty, as if speaking on behalf of someone safe. Warm and sincere. A slight lift at the end—offering the warmth forward, not keeping it.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ひな、ひかりちゃんと、遊べて、楽しい。
lines.en: Hina gets to play with Hikari—that's so fun!
lines.style: Bright and genuine without being performed. The natural delight of a child who's saying something true. Quick, eager rhythm. Real joy, not acted joy.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: こうやって、四世代、揃うって、本当に、奇跡みたい。
lines.en: When four generations come together like this, it really does feel like a miracle.
lines.style: Soft wonder in the voice. Reflective, almost hushed. Speaking as though the moment itself is fragile and precious. Slow pace. The kind of quietness that holds weight.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんも、絶対、見てくれてる。
lines.en: I know Dad is watching over us.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Not trying to convince anyone—simply stating something she knows to be true. Warm and grounded. The slight catch of emotion held steady.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Grandpa is surely happy about this.
lines.style: Soft and sure. Speaking to affirm something unseen but felt. Gentle rise on the final word—offering it forward like a quiet blessing.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: お祖父様も、お祖母様も、ずっと、一緒。
lines.en: Grandpa and Grandma are always with us.
lines.style: Simple and certain. A child's logic delivered with genuine understanding. Warm and matter-of-fact. No sadness—just the quiet knowledge of continuity.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ひな、本当に、優しい子に、なったね。
lines.en: Hina has grown into such a kind child.
lines.style: Spoken with quiet admiration, grandmother to granddaughter. Pride without pressure. The warmth of someone noticing growth and holding it gently. Soft close on the final syllables.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 家族、皆で、育ててもらって、本当に、ありがたい。
lines.en: I'm so grateful that we're all raising Hikari together as a family.
lines.style: Deep gratitude in every word. Speaking to the whole circle. Measured, philosophical—someone taking in the weight of what it means to be held up by family. Slight catch of emotion held with composure.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: これからも、皆さんで、ひかりちゃん、見守ってほしい。
lines.en: From now on too, I hope all of you will look after Hikari.
lines.style: Tender request, not demand. Spoken with quiet trust. The slight vulnerability of asking for what matters most, held with grace. Soft trailing-off at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: もちろん。お祖母ちゃん、ずっと、ね。
lines.en: Of course. Grandma will always be here.
lines.style: Promise made simple and absolute. No elaboration needed. The depth of grandmother-love in just a few words. Warm, steady, quietly eternal.
